请保留小标题和 infos-pr 标记，删除或保留提示注释都可以；提示本身不会被当作回答。
Please keep the headings and infos-pr markers. You may remove the hints; hints do not count as answers.

## 1. 想解决什么问题？ / What problem does this solve?
<!-- infos-pr:problem -->
<!-- 请说说问题、使用场景，并关联 Issue；没有关联也可以直说。 / Describe the problem/use case and link the issue, or say there isn't one. -->

## 2. 做了哪些调整？ / What changed?
<!-- infos-pr:changes -->
<!-- 简述行为变化和涉及的模块，让第一次看这个 PR 的人也能理解。 / Describe the behavior changes and affected modules for someone new to this PR. -->

## 3. 设计如何符合架构？ / How does the design fit the architecture?
<!-- infos-pr:architecture -->
<!-- 引用 .docs 的相关章节，说明职责、依赖、数据归属与权限边界。架构调整请关联已讨论的提案；纯文档等改动可说明为何不影响架构。 / Reference relevant .docs sections and explain ownership, dependencies and permission boundaries. Link an agreed proposal for architectural changes, or explain why your change does not affect the architecture. -->

## 4. 实际怎样验证的？ / How did you verify it?
<!-- infos-pr:verification -->
<!-- 填写实际执行的命令／手动步骤及结果；没运行的请说明原因和未验证范围。无需为了填表新增无意义测试。 / List commands/manual steps actually performed and their results. Explain skipped checks and remaining gaps. No need to add tests just to fill this section. -->

## 5. 运行截图放这里 / Running screenshots
<!-- infos-pr:screenshots -->
<!-- 前端相关变更请直接拖入实际运行截图：已有界面放前后对比，新界面放变更后截图；涉及主题时展示暗／浅色，动效可补视频。仅后端／文档变更写“不涉及前端”即可。 / For frontend changes, embed actual running screenshots here: before/after for an existing UI, after for a new UI, both themes when affected, and optional video for motion. Backend/docs-only changes may say “No frontend changes.” -->

## 6. 升级或使用时需要注意什么？ / Any compatibility or upgrade considerations?
<!-- infos-pr:compatibility -->
<!-- 是否影响数据、配置、公共接口或升级恢复？有的话说明兼容办法；没有可以直接写“无”。 / Mention data, configuration, API or upgrade/recovery impact and how it is handled. “None” is fine when there is no impact. -->
